dict.string: Emuqu reads heart rate, active energy and workouts on your Apple Watch during a workout. Wrist heart rate streams to your iPhone in real time and fills in if your Polar strap drops out.

Emuqu uses HealthKit on your Watch to start a workout session that keeps wrist heart rate streaming back to your iPhone during exercise. The Watch session is discarded when you stop — the canonical workout record is saved by the iPhone, not the Watch.

Emuqu uses Bluetooth on your Apple Watch to connect directly to your Polar H10, Polar Verity Sense, or other standard Heart Rate Profile chest strap or arm band. Direct connection lets the Watch read live HR + RR intervals when your iPhone is out of range or in another room.
